text: Total financing increased from USD 9.8 billion in 2022 to USD 12.4 billion in 2024 (+26.5%).
Employees increased from 1,240 employees in 2023 to 1,310 employees in 2024 (+5.6%).
Infrastructure was the largest share of share of financing at 31%.
2 dated obligations extend beyond 2024, the latest to 30 June 2027.
